sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gaiar was an obscure Irish hero. Some texts name him a son of the doomed lovers Deirdre and Noísiú. A daughter, Aíbgéne, also appears in that telling. The two children surface in only a few versions of the lovers' tale. Otherwise the record says little of Gaiar.

okr.objective: Set down the scarce record of the obscure hero Gaiar.
key_results: Name Gaiar as a son of Deirdre and Noísiú in some texts.
